import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # species label variants: strip, normalize case and known misspellings
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip()
    species_map = {
        'adelie': 'Adelie',
        'adeile': 'Adelie',
        'gentoo': 'Gentoo',
        'gentto': 'Gentoo',
        'chinstrap': 'Chinstrap',
        'chinstarp': 'Chinstrap',
    }
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.lower().replace(species_map)
    # body_mass_g is text with commas -> numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # flipper_length_mm to numeric and remove negative / out of range values
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 0, 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    # year may be stored as text
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    return df

def answer(df):
    dfc = clean(df)
    allowed = ['Adelie', 'Chinstrap', 'Gentoo']
    dfc = dfc[dfc['species'].isin(allowed)]
    totals = dfc.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum(min_count=1)
    # drop NaN groups and return plain Python numbers
    result = {}
    for k, v in totals.items():
        if pd.notna(v):
            # keep as int when whole
            if float(v).is_integer():
                result[k] = int(v)
            else:
                result[k] = float(v)
    return result
